directPaymentDiscovery.note: Official page confirms several contract-free payment methods, but does not publish a complete current tariff mapping for every method/EVSE. SMS has a numeric DC price; Giro-e is described as currently available at DC fast chargers although the tariff table also displays AC and DC values. Web/app prices are not numerically disclosed on the same official surface.

reason: Do not generalize one payment-method tariff to every Norderstedt EVSE. Exact direct-payment numbers exist for specific modes, but the public official surface is not sufficient to map all stations/EVSEs and methods fail-closed.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Official station/EVSE payment-method matrix or public checkout/backend response tying each EVSE to the applicable SMS/web/app/Giro-e tariff.
